summary: Context-only committee memo, as of 2026-09-05: the measured tape remains Risk-on (75), with normalizing volatility, healthy credit, no recession signal, and SPY still in Stage 2. The principal tension is regime transition: the confirmed US label is Q2 Reflation, but the current growth/inflation axes read Q3 and have accumulated 5 of the required 7 confirmation sessions. Separately, the growth-scare radar is at watch (64.2, rising) while its own measured 21-session pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate; therefore it is an early contextual tension, not a forecast or measured adverse edge. Liquidity is neutral-hollow, with the RRP buffer exhausted, but credit and funding stress are not confirming. Factor evidence is not decision-grade: only 10 panel dates are available, the >=60-date Pair G gate is unmet, no factor contradictions exist, no factor attention items have been graded, and the survivorship-biased scorecard has no surviving legs. The broad spine query was capped and dominated by repeated Canadian-board horizon rows using unsigned MFE proxies; these are not comparable with signed-excess claims and cannot support a family-level reliability conclusion. Kernel evidence likewise shows no armed engines in the returned set. No hypothesis was staked because the available observations did not justify spending the limited weekly budget on a sufficiently isolated causal claim.
